# Position constraints

for bird in birds:
    solver.add(pos[bird] >= 1, pos[bird] <= 5)

solver.add(Distinct(*[pos[bird] for bird in birds]))

solver.add(pos["sandpipers"] < pos["oystercatchers"])

    And(hall[0] == True, hall[1] == True),

    And(hall[1] == True, hall[4] == True),
